categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing CIGU Technology Corp., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of magnetic levitation fluid machinery and core components such as magnetic levitation bearings, high-speed motors, and high-speed drives. Its main products include magnetic levitation centrifugal blowers, magnetic levitation air compressors, magnetic levitation chillers, and magnetic levitation vacuum pumps, serving industries like wastewater treatment, chemical, textile, food, pharmaceutical, and paper manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include five-degree-of-freedom magnetic levitation bearings, high-power high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motors, specialized high-speed motor frequency converters, high-efficiency centrifugal impellers and flow components, and integrated magnetic levitation system development. Production methods emphasize advanced electromagnetic control, high-frequency vector modulation, and fluid dynamics optimization based on three-dimensional flow theory, enabling frictionless, oil-free, energy-efficient, and low-noise operation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises in wastewater treatment, chemical processing, textile and dyeing, food production, pharmaceuticals, paper manufacturing, electronics, and other sectors requiring high-efficiency fluid machinery. The company’s products are widely applied in municipal and industrial projects across these industries, with significant market penetration in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales covering all provinces and municipalities nationwide. Major revenue contributions come from economically developed regions such as East China, Central China, North China, Northeast China, South China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. The company also has growing international sales, though domestic markets remain dominant.
categories.supply_chain_position: CIGU Technology operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of high-tech magnetic levitation fluid machinery and related components. It procures raw materials and components such as electronic parts, impellers, and cabinets, and assembles finished products for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and product iteration, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on expanding product lines and enhancing core technologies like magnetic levitation bearings, high-speed motors, and frequency converters. Key R&D projects include second-generation magnetic levitation centrifugal blowers, magnetic levitation air compressors, magnetic levitation refrigeration compressors, and magnetic levitation turbo vacuum pumps, aiming to broaden applications and improve energy efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of magnetic levitation fluid machinery products and related components. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales and authorized distributors, with contracts typically involving staged payments based on project progress and acceptance. Additionally, contract energy management services contribute to revenue through shared energy savings with customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider of magnetic levitation fluid machinery in China, competing with both traditional blower and compressor manufacturers and emerging magnetic levitation technology firms. It holds a strong market position due to its advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product portfolio, and growing brand recognition, gradually replacing imported products in the domestic market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 413.56 million, representing a 20.16% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 48.06 million, a slight increase of 0.90%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding product sales, especially in magnetic levitation air compressors which grew by over 80%. Total assets reached RMB 1.38 billion, with net assets of RMB 960.84 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CIGU Technology emphasizes its products’ unique value of frictionless magnetic levitation bearings enabling high-speed, oil-free, low-noise, and energy-efficient operation. Its magnetic levitation fluid machinery offers significant energy savings (e.g., 25-30% for blowers, 20% for air compressors, 30-50% for chillers, and over 40% for vacuum pumps) compared to traditional equipment, along with reduced maintenance costs and environmental benefits. The company’s proprietary technologies and comprehensive product range provide tailored solutions across diverse industrial applications.
